job.title: Senior Forward Deployed Engineer
job.location: Denver, CO · New York, NY · San Francisco, CA
job.pay_full: $154,000 – $205,000 a year (reasonably estimated yearly salary), plus equity and possibly variable compensation

details.about: Datadog's Implementation Services team runs end-to-end deployment and optimization projects. Its Forward Deployed Engineers own the discovery, design and build of the Datadog platform in customer environments: deploying Datadog, migrating customers off legacy platforms, optimizing existing deployments, and working with Product and Engineering on design partnerships with strategic customers adopting new products.
duties: Lead technical planning, design and delivery of migration, optimization and observability transformation projects
Work closely with customer teams to understand their needs and support adoption
Structure build efforts around complexity and timelines
Deploy and configure Datadog across cloud, Kubernetes and on-prem infrastructure with Terraform, Ansible and CI/CD pipelines
Turn one-off tools into reusable patterns for future projects
Lead design partnerships with strategic customers adopting new Datadog products
needs: 8+ years in software engineering, SRE, DevOps, platform engineering, or customer-facing technical roles such as professional services or solutions engineering
Proven ability to architect solutions, win buy-in on designs and drive builds to completion
Production-quality code or automation in Python, Go, TypeScript or similar
Strong knowledge of at least one major cloud (AWS, GCP or Azure), plus Kubernetes, Terraform or Ansible, and CI/CD
Hands-on observability experience with Datadog or a comparable platform
Daily use of AI coding tools
Able to sit up to 4 hours and travel by car, train or air up to 30% of the time
details.benefits: Reasonably estimated yearly salary $154,000 – $205,000; compensation is a competitive salary and equity package and may include variable compensation. Benefits include healthcare, dental, parental planning and mental health benefits, a 401(k) plan and match, paid time off, fitness reimbursements, new-hire RSUs and a discounted employee stock purchase plan, plus onboarding, mentoring and professional development.
notes: Travel up to 30% of the time
Datadog encourages people who don't meet every qualification on day one to apply
